title: EVO Adapter Parts by VapeXhale
description:
LETS GET CONNECTED.
We offer EVO adapter parts in case you want to make up your own adapter kit or if the unthinkable happens and you have to replace a brocken adapter on your existing EVO adapter kit.
All 18 mm female adaptors are unground giving a unique smooth feeling not usually associated with glass on glass. All other joints are ground glass joint.
Please select the adaptor you are looking for we currently have the following.
18 mm female adapter ( unground )
18 mm male adapter ( ground glass joint )
14 mm male adapter ( ground glass joint )
60 cm medical grade silicone hose
